body.x: The Seoul Metropolitan Government announced on December 9 that it will operate its largest-ever exhibition space for Seoul-based advanced startups at CES 2025, the world’s largest consumer electronics and ICT trade show.
CES (Consumer Electronics Show), held annually in Las Vegas, is a global tech arena where companies like Samsung and Google unveil their future visions and startups present innovative technologies.
From January 7 to 10, 2025, Seoul will host 1,040㎡ “Seoul Pavilion” at Eureka Park, CES’s dedicated startup exhibition zone. This is a 50% increase in space compared to the previous year.
The Seoul Pavilion at CES 2025 will feature more startups and award-winning companies than ever, reflecting the city’s growing presence in the global tech scene since its debut in CES 2020.

The pavilion will showcase cutting-edge technologies from Seoul-based AI, lifestyle, and healthcare companies. The city plans to facilitate global market entry through on-site investor matching, competitions, and other dynamic programs.

body.cap: CES 2025 Seoul Pavilion Rendering │Image by Seoul Business Agency

body.x: This year’s exhibition will involve 104 startups from 16 organizations, including three Seoul districts (Gangnam, Geumcheon, and Gwanak), five startup support agencies (SBA, Seoul Tourism Organization, Seoul Biohub, Seoul AI Hub, and CampusTown Enterprise Growth Center), and eight universities (Konkuk, Kyung Hee, Kookmin, Dongguk, Sogang, University of Seoul, Yonsei, and Chung-Ang).

The city will run a support program matching each startup with a student supporter from these eight universities to assist participating companies. A total of 103 outstanding student supporters will provide comprehensive on-site exhibition assistance.
Exhibitors will receive full operational support, including booth setup, innovation award consulting, buyer matching, on-site IR presentations, and media promotion.

A record 21 participating startups will receive the CES 2025 Innovation Awards. Presented annually by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), the awards recognize outstanding technology, design, and innovation products.

body.cap: CES 2025 Seoul Pavilion Rendering │Image by Seoul Business Agency

body.x: The CES 2025 Seoul Pavilion Innovation Award winners include Leadpoint System, Apollon, GenGenAI, MTS Company, Jiro Inc., IPIN Labs, Route Finders, Seomjae, AFS, Otiton Medical, STUDIO LAB, Prevenotics, Triplet, VivaInnovation, UniUni, CameloTech, Thermoeye, Korea I.T.S., CUBIC-K, MeTown, and Barunbio.

To prepare for CES 2025, the Seoul Business Agency held a launch ceremony on November 29 at Sogang University, gathering participating companies and organizations for networking and an overview of exhibition support services, including booth operations, business matching, and support programs. IT trend and business capability workshops were also held. Student supporters were matched with companies and began collaborative planning for the event.

Hyun-woo Kim, CEO of Seoul Business Agency, stated, “CES 2025 will be a key platform for showcasing Seoul’s innovative technologies and startup ecosystem to the global market. We will actively support Seoul-based startups with advanced technologies to help them achieve continued global success.”

body.cap: Hyun-woo Kim, CEO of Seoul Business Agency, delivers opening remarks at the CES 2025 Seoul Pavilion Launch Ceremony. │Photo by Seoul Business Agency

body.x: AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, plans to launch several programs to boost the global reach of Korean SMEs and startups.

They will set up the AVING BROADCASTING ZONE at the Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, host the CES Media Day Startup Conference, and organize global media interviews to share Korean startup news worldwide. International media reporters affiliated with Aving News will cover all programs.

After CES 2025, AVING News will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea to enhance corporate visibility. Before CES, they will also share key CES participation strategies with domestic SMEs and startups, invite two global media outlets for pre-event interviews, and arrange online interviews between startups and overseas media representatives.
This news is part of the joint project between AVING News and SBA(Seoul Business Agency)
